subtitle: Month-by-month overview of the Active Inference Institute's ongoing year, 2026.
audience: Members, participants, collaborators, and the public who want a consolidated, month-by-month view of the Institute's ongoing year in 2026.
lede: 2026 is the Active Inference Institute's ongoing year — a consolidated, month-by-month entry point to the activities, programs, and events that are running across the organization under the motto Act. Infer. Serve., in the same format as the 2025 annual overview. The Activities page and Calendar remain the most reliable way to see what's happening week to week. The detailed record continues to be maintained on the 2026 hub.

sections.heading: The Year So Far
sections.body: This page gathers the Institute's 2026 work into a single overview, organized by month, as the year unfolds. As a participatory, open-science 501(c)(3) nonprofit, the Institute conducts its work in public, so this overview is best read as a map to the year's activities, programs, and events. See the History page for how the year fits the Institute's longer story.

sections.heading: January
sections.body: Institute Programs and Activities begin for the year, and Institute Structure is clarified. Work continues with the Board of Directors and the Scientific Advisory Board, connected to Strategy and Ecosystem Development. The January newsletter is published.

sections.heading: February
sections.body: The February newsletter is published, covering the month's Institute and Ecosystem activity.

sections.heading: March
sections.body: March 27 — 2026 Quarterly Roundtable #1. The March newsletter is also published.

sections.heading: Full materials
sections.body: The complete, continuously updated record of 2026 goals, milestones, and events is maintained on the 2026 hub and is being migrated onto this site.

cards.title: Governance for 2026
cards.text: January brings Institute Structure clarification and continued work with the Board of Directors and Scientific Advisory Board.

cards.title: Quarterly Roundtables
cards.text: Two of the year's four 2026 Quarterly Roundtables have livestreamed so far — March 27 (#1) and June 26 (#2).

cards.title: 6th Applied Active Inference Symposium
cards.text: The call for presenters is open for the 6th Applied Active Inference Symposium, running online 12–14 November 2026.

cards.title: Newsletter
cards.text: Monthly newsletters cover Institute and Ecosystem activity as the year unfolds.
